wish: someone should make a web-based icon editor
spec:
Draws pixel icons on a 16 to 64 px grid with pencil, fill, eraser, eyedropper, palette, custom colour and undo.
Tap or drag on the grid; pick a size; export a PNG at actual size or 8x, or an SVG.
Does not import images, layers or animate; the drawing is kept only in this browser.
